_comment: Craft app CLIs bundled into the Studio image. Only list an app here after checking by hand that its --automation-read-root/--automation-write-root flags refuse every path outside the root (absolute paths, ../, and symlinks), because Studio runs one copy per signed-in user on a shared server. Also hide tools that need the desktop app or reach outside the session (printing, OS keychains, script consoles), and list in blocked_commands any engine command the generic command tools could reach that does (network sharing, plug-ins). Some apps accept the flags without enforcing them, so test before adding; never add an app because its --help lists the flags. sha256 values are the release's linux tarballs, copied from its SHA256SUMS.txt.

apps.name: wordcraft
apps.title: WordCraft
apps.description: Word processor: create and edit docx, odt, rtf, markdown and text documents, and export them to PDF.

apps.name: deckcraft
apps.title: DeckCraft
apps.description: Presentations: build and edit pptx slide decks with layouts, shapes, pictures, tables and charts, and export slides to PDF or images.

apps.name: pdfcraft
apps.title: PdfCraft
apps.description: PDF editor: edit text and pages, combine and split, fill and create forms, redact, comment, OCR, check accessibility, and export to Word, PowerPoint, text or images.

apps.name: photocraft
apps.title: PhotoCraft
apps.description: Photo editor: layers, adjustments, filters, selections and text on PNG, JPEG, WebP, TIFF and PSD images, saved as images or lossless .pcraft projects.
apps.confinement_checked: 2026-10-31, 0.17.0 linux-aarch64: 16 of 16 escape attempts refused (a save onto a symlink replaces the link and leaves its target untouched)

apps.name: vectorcraft
apps.title: VectorCraft
apps.description: Vector art: draw paths, shapes, text and graphs, apply effects and pathfinder operations, and export to PDF or PNG.
apps.confinement_checked: 2026-10-31, 0.18.0 linux-aarch64 with --headless: 20 of 20 escape attempts refused. Without --headless it first tries to attach to a desktop app on 127.0.0.1:7979, so --headless is required.

apps.name: designcraft
apps.title: DesignCraft
apps.description: Page layout: build multi-page documents with text frames, images and styles, open IDML, and export to PDF or PNG.
apps.confinement_checked: 2026-10-31, 0.14.0 linux-aarch64: 50 of 50 escape attempts refused, including file.package, links.copyTo, file.recovery.* and paths inside script.run and batch. Printing and URLs fail; no listening ports opened.

apps.name: figcraft
apps.title: FigCraft
apps.description: Interface design: frames, shapes, text, components and auto layout; open .fig files and export to PNG, JPG, PDF or WebP.
apps.confinement_checked: 2026-10-31, 0.12.1 linux-aarch64: 24 of 24 escape attempts refused. collab.host can open a listening live-session server and plug-ins run JavaScript and install from an online directory, so collab.*, publishing and plug-in commands are blocked.

apps.name: soundcraft
apps.title: SoundCraft
apps.description: Audio editing and mixing: import audio and MIDI, arrange clips on tracks, mix, and bounce to WAV, AIFF or FLAC.
apps.confinement_checked: 2026-10-31, 0.14.0 linux-aarch64: 79 of 79 file escape attempts refused, including clip and stem exports. setup.disk_allocation accepts a record folder outside the root (nothing was written there headless), so it is blocked. A plug-in file in the session folder is not loaded.
